title: Clear a saved reading preference
goal: Use removeItem to delete a key and restore the page status synchronously.
summary: Readers can save compact display preferences or restore defaults. Other personal settings continue to be retained.
tasks: reads density at startup and writes #density if it exists; "standard" is displayed when there is no value.
Clicking #reset-density removes the density and immediately displays "standard" on the page.

example.note: removeItem removes only the specified key; it can also be safely called for keys that do not exist.

hint: The restore button only handles density. Do not call clear() to clear other keys.
